Any mission to any orbit

Launch solutions for every mission, to every orbit

For over 40 years, Arianespace has partnered with commercial and institutional customers, offering a
versatile family of launchers that delivers satellites for telecommunications, navigation, Earth
observation, scientific research and technology demonstrations.

[ DISCOVER OUR SOLUTIONS
][34]

launch services

## We are
## the experts
## in launch services

Arianespace dedicates all of its expertise to fulfilling its customers’ space ambitions. With
flexible launch solutions and personalized support, our experts ensure your missions are a success,
making each project a unique, memorable adventure.

[ Discover our launch services
][35]

ARIANE 6

## The perfect launch vehicle for all your missions and orbit requirements

Ariane 6

862TTypical lift-off mass

Discover Ariane 6, the new-generation heavy launcher that combines reliability, versatility, and
performance, operated by Arianespace. This launcher is designed to efficiently meet the diverse
needs of our customers. With its advanced technical capabilities and enhanced performance, Ariane 6
offers an optimal solution for a wide range of space missions.

[ Discover Ariane 6
][36]

Ground services experts

## We are the experts
## in ground services

Arianespace relies on the expertise of its teams to orchestrate each launch with precision and
rigor. From logistics to the meticulous preparation of satellites, every stage is carefully managed
to ensure the success of our customers' missions and to meet the highest standards of the space
industry.

[ Discover our ground services
][37]

[Reaching Real Circularity]

### Reaching Real Circularity

"At Ball, we strive to create the perfect circle for our packaging products so that the materials
can be used over and over. We are striving toward our 2030 commitments."
 
* Align the industry to achieve a 90% global recycling rate for aluminum beverage cans, bottles and
  cups (2030).
* Work together with our supply chain partners to achieve an 85% average recycled content in the
  aluminum used to produce beverage cans, bottles and cups in the regions where we operate (2030).
* Launch second generation of ReAl® aerosol container technology with 75% recycled content (2030).

# India

[Earth with data connection points]

## Indian Innovation

L3Harris is involved with a full range of projects in India, supporting the nation’s civil and
military goals. From defense and paramilitary to public safety, aviation and space, L3Harris is
providing the technologies for a modern, self-reliant India.

Editorial

#### AERIS X Airborne Early Warning & Control: The Right Choice for Allied Homeland Defense

L3Harris’ AERIS X airborne early warning and control (AEW&C) solution represents a shift in how
allies approach airborne intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance and mission systems
capabilities – proven performance, sustainable economics and operational readiness that matches the
threat timeline.

[ Read more ][8]
[submarine surfacing]

Editorial

#### Maintaining America's Undersea Edge: L3Harris Secures Towed Array Production Through 2029

L3Harris secures critical U.S. Navy contracts to continue delivering cutting-edge towed array
systems that strengthen submarine detection and undersea superiority.

[ Read more ][9]
[Soldier speaks into radio]

Press release

#### L3Harris and KSSL Sign MOU to Collaborate on Advanced Technology in India

L3Harris Technologies and Kalyani Strategic Systems Limited (KSSL), a subsidiary of Bharat Forge
Limited, signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) for wider collaboration in supporting advanced
defense and security equipment in India.

[ Read more ][10]

## OUR MISSION

As the Trusted Disruptor, we innovate relentlessly and deliver capability with the speed, passion
and determination that our customers demand in executing their most challenging missions.

## The Angstrom Technology Cleanroom Design Experts

As the authority on all things cleanrooms, we pride ourselves on our expertise in the design,
construction, installation, and service of cleanrooms, controlled environments, and modular offices.

A focus on excellence and innovation has led Angstrom Technology to be recognized as one of the top
manufacturers of high quality modular cleanrooms. Since 1989, we’ve worked to put our customers’
needs first and continue to grow into new industry specialities and service areas. From turnkey
cleanroom projects to large-scale production environments, we can deliver the ideal cleanroom for
your application.

At Angstrom Technology, we understand that cleanrooms aren’t one-size-fits-all, which is why we
offer four cleanroom types: modular SoftWall Cleanrooms, HardWall Cleanrooms, and RigidWall
Cleanrooms, as well as traditional Seamless Wall Solutions. While each cleanroom type may have
different advantages and capabilities, the ideal cleanroom for you will depend on your cleanroom
classification, industry requirements, facility space, and other project needs.

No matter what cleanroom type you choose, the experts at Angstrom Technology can design, build, and
install it with minimum disruption to your operations.

How much time do I need per week?
Plan for roughly 2 to 3 hours per week for live lectures and office hours, or 4 to 5 hours per week

Every live lecture is recorded and made available on the learning platform shortly after, so you can
catch up on your own schedule. Office hours are also offered in multiple time zones each week, so if
you miss one you can simply join another.

mechanism.

right partner or a special skillset or tool, call us today. Together we’ll create and refine your
plan for success. We didn’t get there alone. And neither will you.

Established in 2014, Deep Cycle Systems (DCS) is a well-known Australian technology company with the
mission to provide quality services to its clientele across global markets. With its advanced

provide our clients with the best in the market.


As of 2023, Deep Cycle Systems has expanded into the European market, distributing our most popular
lithium batteries. With years of experience working with end users, government departments,
designing vehicle fleet systems and working with OEM marine and RV manufacturers, we pride ourselves
on our professionalism and dedication to our customers. Deep Cycle Systems now provides lithium
batteries to various customers across different industries throughout Europe. Our focus is currently
on the 12V Emergency Services market along with Marine & RV's.


Our batteries are similar-sized to lead-acid batteries, which makes upgrading to DCS Lithium
Batteries a simple task whilst significantly improving the battery life. DCS Lithium Batteries are
lightweight yet durable and long-lasting due to their superior construction. Our products are
designed to be used in a variety of applications, including military, emergency, marine & motorhomes
and other RV's. We manufacture our products with care and attention to detail so that they can
provide maximum service life.

#### DCS Battery Management System (BMS)

The DCS Battery Management System (BMS) project was initiated to address the shortcomings of basic
Chinese-designed BMSs, which lacked features and programmability. The goal was to create a robust,
reliable, and high-performance BMS capable of continuous high current pass through operation using
high-quality components, minimal temperature increase at peak output, and suitable for engine
cranking applications and high-temperature environments. The design also includes Bluetooth and WiFi
connectivity for app integration into cloud server, OTA updates and passes MIL vibration testing
standards.

# A Superpower In

# Batteries and Energetic Devices

[Our Products][36]

Powering Mission Success
83,828582,818482,878183
Over 3 billion hours* in space without a mission failure!
^{*}*Approximate cell hours.*
For Diverse Markets
 

EaglePicher is a leading American battery and energetic devices designer and manufacturer. We have
the capability to generate unique and technically advanced designs, then take them to production
levels that satisfy our customer’s needs. The industries we serve include:
* [Defense][37]
* [Aerospace][38]
* [Energetics][39]

## EaglePicher is Your Powerful Partner

#### Trusted Power. Innovative Power. Reliable Power.

Our niche battery technology company is the industry leader in available chemistries and
technologies, and we have the results to prove it:
* EaglePicher is the #1 U.S. battery manufacturer of thermal battery systems.
* We supply power for over 90% of the U.S. military’s munitions and mission critical systems.
* More than 600 satellites currently in orbit are operating under EaglePicher power.
* [Technology][40]
* [Products][41]

## Delivering Power

EaglePicher Technologies has been an industry leading American battery manufacturer in integrated
power solutions for nearly a century. Demands on technology call for batteries and devices that are
both smaller and lighter, yet deliver more energy and increase safety. In response to these demands,
we bring you the newest technology innovations, custom battery development, and support from concept
through production.

Our battery technology company employs over 250 astute scientists and accomplished engineers.
Working with our state-of-the-art equipment and facilities, our team creates energy storage
solutions to meet your specialized power needs. Whether it’s our cutting-edge research on
lithium-ion technology or providing power to critical defense systems, we continue to set new
standards. Our goal is to ensure that the right power is always available — not just for
convenience, but when it’s a matter of life and death.

### A Little Bit About Us

Headquartered in Joplin, Missouri, EaglePicher is an American-owned and operated battery technology
company that makes batteries by utilizing the most advanced technology and innovative processes.
Founded in 1843 as a mining and paint manufacturing business, the company entered the battery market
in 1922. In the 1940s, we were awarded our first special-purpose battery contract. After an
EaglePicher battery was launched into space aboard NASA’s Explorer 1 satellite in 1958, our
specialty battery business really took off.


### Your One-Stop Shop

Let EaglePicher provide the power and energetics solutions for your next high reliability
application. Our breadth of battery chemistries and energetic devices coupled with our ability to
design and develop system solutions makes us the most diversified American energy solution provider
in the world. When you demand the highest quality and most reliable battery performance, EaglePicher
is the only name you need to know.

[EaglePicher proudly operates as a Small Business while offering the stability and capabilities
typically associated with a Large Business. Click here to learn more.][42]

# Thinking Batteries Further

We shape the future of transportation as a top tier technology-partner for the e-mobility sector,
offering sustainable energy storage solutions researched, developed, manufactured and trusted
world-wide.

We think batteries further!

[Read more][33]

### Solutions

Our solution portfolio offers a wide range of tailor-made and off-the-shelf products as well as
numerous services to make your batteries even better.

[Solutions][34]

### Products

Our products are made in world class manufacturing factories with a focus on sustainability and
performance.

[Products][35]

### Research & Development

We have a continuously growing team of highly trained experts working on new solutions in all major
markets supporting in pre-development, development and series support.

[Engineering][36]

### Sustainability

Our approach to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) aligns with European sustainability goals,
emphasizing responsible product development and production. In line with the EU Battery Regulation
(2023/1542), we ensure compliance with strict sustainability, safety, and recycling requirements.

[Sustainability][37]

### Career

We are an international team that fosters people with a passion for sustainable technologies by
giving them the opportunity to create the change they envision for themselves and for the world, and
help us shape the future of e-mobility.

[Career][38]

### Contact

How can we help? Looking forward to hearing from you!

[Contact][39]

GSL ENERGY provides advanced battery energy storage systems (BESS) for residential, commercial, and
industrial applications. Our energy storage solutions support solar integration, peak shaving,
backup power, microgrids, and large-scale energy management worldwide.

### Energy Savings

When a solar system generates more energy than needed, GSL Energy's battery can store the surplus
for you instead of letting the excess energy go to waste. It can also recharge from the grid during
off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower..

### 24/7 Availability

The stored energy can be used whenever needed, whether during the day or night, or even in the event
of a power outage. GSL Energy's battery energy storage system can power your entire home, including
essential household appliances such as A/C and refrigerator.

### Cost Effectiveness

The system saves you money by analyzing your power usage patterns, weather forecasts, and utility
price predictions to ensure optimal efficiency. Excess stored energy can be sold back to the grid to
generate additional revenue.

# High-Reliability Space
# Batteries for Every Scale of Mission

GS Yuasa has delivered industry-leading cumulative Li-ion flight heritage, with more than 5 MWh
flown. We continue to power the most demanding large spacecraft programs with proven large-format
cells while now bringing that same trusted electrochemistry to smallsats through the MA12x platform.

## Heritage That Scales

GS Yuasa has built its reputation on delivering industry-leading reliability for the highest-stakes
space missions. We continue to supply large-format cells for demanding high-reliability programs
while now also offering the LSE12x cell and MA12x platform — extending that same proven
electrochemistry and manufacturing standards to smallsats.

All spacecraft classes benefit from the same foundation: consistent chemistry, rigorous
qualification, and decades of real flight data, along with advanced modeling tools that enable
precise right-sizing for each mission.

Large-format LSE cells powering critical GEO, MEO, LEO, and human-rated programs for over 25 years.

LARGE SPACECRAFT & HIGH-RELIABILITY PROGRAMS

## Trusted Where Reliability Is Non-Negotiable

GS Yuasa large-format LSE cells have powered flagship programs across GEO, MEO, LEO, and beyond —
including multiple Cygnus CRS missions, ISS battery replacements, Van Allen Probes, and planetary
defense programs.

[ Explore Large-Format LSE Cells ][22]
[GS Yuasa large-format LSE cell line-up]

Large-format LSE cells — over 5.0 MWh deployed in space with zero failures.

Consistent Chemistry Across 25+ Years

Same fundamental LCO/Graphite system refined across four generations.

Proven on Long-Duration Missions

Multiple programs operating successfully beyond 15–20 years on orbit with no cell failures.

Advanced Right-Sizing Support

Proprietary life and performance modeling tools help programs accurately size batteries without
costly oversizing.

SMALLSAT POWER

## Extending Proven Performance to Smallsats

The LSE12x cell delivers GS Yuasa’s proven Gen 4 LCO chemistry in a compact 12 Ah format optimized
for high-pulse power and demanding smallsat duty cycles. The MA12x platform scales from 720 Wh to
4,320 Wh, delivering the reliability large programs have trusted for decades through rigorous
manufacturing quality and consistency.

[ Explore the MA12x Platform → ][23]
[MA12x modular battery configurations]

MA12x platform — scalable from 720Wh to 4,320Wh in a single volume efficient package

High-Pulse Power Capability

Delivers exceptional discharge rates and voltage stability under the high-pulse, eccentric duty
cycles typical of LEO smallsats.

Constellation Economics

Scalable production supports rapid delivery of the quantities needed for constellation programs on
tight schedules.

Qualification Complete

Full qualification test data package available immediately. Accelerates program schedules by
leveraging existing heritage data instead of starting from scratch.

WHY LEADING PROGRAMS CHOOSE GS YUASA

## The GS Yuasa Difference

Real Flight Heritage

Not just qualified on paper. Proven across hundreds of thousands of cell-hours on actual missions,
including multiple programs exceeding 15–20 years on orbit.

Purpose-Built for Space

Unlike many competitors that adapt commercial cells, GS Yuasa’s LSE family was designed from the
ground up for the thermal, radiation, and long-life demands of space. This enables higher
performance and mass efficiency without the compromises of terrestrial designs.

Chemistry Consistency

All GS Yuasa space cells are based on the LCO/Graphite Li-ion chemistry. Only four generations have
been developed. After qualification, each generation’s chemistry is locked. GS Yuasa has held these
configurations stable for more than 15 years.

Advanced Life & Performance Modeling

Our advanced modeling tools enable EPS engineers to forecast end-of-life performance and precisely
size batteries for each mission. The result is lower mass and cost with greater confidence — the
same capability used across both large spacecraft and smallsat programs. See mission modeling
examples on the [Large Spacecraft][24] [

# Equipment Across 5 Continents][81]

[ IndianWeb2 Desk ][82]
[Friday, July 24, 2026][83] [ No comments ][84] [0][85]
L&T Heavy Engineering, the hi-tech manufacturing arm of Larsen & Toubro, has secured a series of
international orders across Asia, Africa, North America, South America and Europe, reinforcing its
position as a global leader in process plant equipment.

The business has secured orders from Africa’s largest industrial conglomerate, Dangote Group, for a
mega refinery and multi-train fertiliser expansion projects in Nigeria and Ethiopia. The scope
includes the supply of critical process equipment, comprising the world’s largest Fluid Catalytic
Cracking Reactor Regenerator Package, all critical urea and ammonia equipment.

Additionally, the business has won a repeat order from a Japanese customer for the manufacture and
supply of Heat Exchangers and Absorbers for an LNG project in Canada. The business has also secured
orders for its core equipment including Coke Drums, Fractionator Columns and Heat Exchangers from
customers in Spain, US and Brazil.

Commenting on this, **Anil Parab, Whole-time Director & Sr Executive Vice President - Manufacturing,
L&T) **said: “These orders reaffirm the trust and confidence that customers place in L&T’s
world-class manufacturing capabilities and its consistent track record of delivering high-quality
process equipment to global clients”.

cutting-edge technology, we ensure your mission achieves excellence – whether it's Earth
observation, communication, or scientific exploration.

ICEPS is available in three variants, ensuring customised mission performance. Talk with our experts

# About Us

Company Profile

KABIT GLOBAL NEW ENERGY is a global battery swap solution provider, offering **integrated systems
that connect vehicles, batteries, swap cabinets, apps, and cloud platforms**—enabling efficient
energy supply and driving the electrification of global transportation.

KABIT GLOBAL NEW ENERGY is also the leader in high-performance battery systems, specializing in
advanced energy solutions for industrial** UAVs, robotics, and energy storage** (ESS). Leveraging 20
years of expertise and 110+ patents, we integrate **high energy density semi-solid-state
technology** with deep **BMS** optimization to deliver unmatched safety and energy density.

Operating six intelligent manufacturing bases, we provide end-to-end services from cell** R&D** to
global engineering implementation. Committed to the “Sustainable, responsible, and circular battery
value chain” goals, KABIT GLOBAL drives the transition to sustainable energy through
“Standardization & Customization” and transparent, automated production—ensuring high-performance
power for the world’s most demanding applications.

# About Us

Company Profile

KABIT GLOBAL NEW ENERGY is a global battery swap solution provider, offering **integrated systems
that connect vehicles, batteries, swap cabinets, apps, and cloud platforms**—enabling efficient
energy supply and driving the electrification of global transportation.

KABIT GLOBAL NEW ENERGY is also the leader in high-performance battery systems, specializing in
advanced energy solutions for industrial** UAVs, robotics, and energy storage** (ESS). Leveraging 20
years of expertise and 110+ patents, we integrate **high energy density semi-solid-state
technology** with deep **BMS** optimization to deliver unmatched safety and energy density.

Operating six intelligent manufacturing bases, we provide end-to-end services from cell** R&D** to
global engineering implementation. Committed to the “Sustainable, responsible, and circular battery
value chain” goals, KABIT GLOBAL drives the transition to sustainable energy through
“Standardization & Customization” and transparent, automated production—ensuring high-performance
power for the world’s most demanding applications.

## What Are Lithium Batteries?

Lithium batteries use advanced lithium-ion chemistry to store and deliver electrical energy more
efficiently, safely, and reliably than conventional lead-acid batteries.

1

#### Welcome to Radix

# Power Solutions Private Limited.

Thank you for visiting our website. We are delighted to welcome you and invite you to discover our
journey, our values, and our commitment to powering a sustainable future. This platform offers an
insight into who we are, what we stand for, and how we continue to innovate in the evolving energy
landscape. Here, you'll also find updates on our latest products, technologies, and milestones.

Established in 2001 in Meerut, India, Radix Power Solutions Private Limited has earned a reputation
as one of India's trusted manufacturers of advanced energy storage solutions. For over two decades,
we have been dedicated to delivering products that combine superior quality, reliability,
innovation, and exceptional performance.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious—to manufacture world-class energy solutions that empower homes,
businesses, industries, and the mobility sector while contributing to a cleaner and more sustainable
future.

### Comprehensive Energy Solutions

At Radix, we believe that the future belongs to integrated energy ecosystems. Our diverse portfolio
is designed to meet the growing energy demands across multiple sectors and includes:

Lead Acid Batteries for Inverter Applications
Solar Energy Storage Batteries
Automotive Batteries
E-Rickshaw Batteries
Industrial Energy Storage Solutions
Lithium Batteries for Electric Mobility
Solar Power Generating Systems
Complete Solar Energy Solutions for Residential, Commercial & Industrial Applications

From reliable battery storage to renewable power generation, we deliver end-to-end energy solutions
that ensure uninterrupted power, maximum efficiency, and long-term value.

#### Engineering Excellence

Every Radix product is manufactured using advanced technology, modern production facilities, and
stringent quality control systems. Our focus on continuous innovation enables us to develop energy
solutions that meet international standards while exceeding customer expectations. Supported by a
passionate workforce of 350+ highly skilled professionals, we foster a culture of innovation,
precision engineering, and customer-centricity. Their expertise and dedication form the backbone of
our success and enable us to consistently deliver products our customers can trust.

#### Driving the Green Energy Revolution

As the global energy industry transitions toward cleaner technologies, Radix continues to evolve
with it.In 2025, we proudly expanded our manufacturing capabilities by launching our Lithium Battery
production facility for the E-Rickshaw segment, marking a major milestone in our journey towards
sustainable mobility. Building on this success, we are actively expanding our Lithium Battery
portfolio for Inverter and Automotive applications, reinforcing our position as a comprehensive
energy storage solutions provider. Simultaneously, we are strengthening our presence in the
renewable energy sector through our Solar Power Generating Systems, offering integrated solar
solutions that help customers reduce energy costs, improve energy independence, and contribute to a
greener planet. Our vision is to become a complete energy partner—providing advanced battery
technologies alongside intelligent renewable energy systems that power tomorrow's world.

#### Our Commitment

At Radix, quality is not merely a standard—it is our promise.

Every product we manufacture reflects our unwavering commitment to innovation, durability, safety,
and customer satisfaction. We believe that lasting relationships are built on trust, transparency,
and consistent performance. As we continue to expand our capabilities and embrace emerging
technologies, our focus remains unchanged: delivering dependable energy solutions that improve
lives, empower businesses, and support sustainable development.

#### Our Vision

To become a globally respected energy solutions company by delivering innovative battery
technologies and renewable energy systems that create a cleaner, smarter, and more sustainable
future.

#### Our Mission

To manufacture world-class batteries and energy storage solutions using advanced technology. To
provide reliable and efficient solar power generating systems for homes, businesses, and industries.

To continuously innovate and adopt emerging energy technologies.

Sure Power, Inc. is a partner you can depend on when your company relies on uninterruptible power.
Data centers, computer rooms and network closets are home to your company’s most important asset –
data. Computer systems, medical equipment, phones, lights and immediate response systems rely on
battery backup to prevent downtime for employees and customers. As networks continue to expand and
become more complex, reliable battery backup for mission-critical systems is essential to your
success.

availability of mission-critical data, communications and applications. With three decades of
experience protecting critical systems from downtime, data loss and equipment damage, we are able to

# Track The Sky — Real-Time 3D Satellite Tracker

Track over 9,000 satellites in real time on an interactive 3D globe. Monitor [space stations][1],
[Starlink][2], [GPS][3], [weather satellites][4], and more with live orbital data updated every two
hours from CelesTrak.

## Satellite Categories
* **[Space Stations][5]** — ISS, CSS, and related objects (approximately 30 satellites)
* **[Starlink][6]** — SpaceX Starlink constellation (approximately 6,000 satellites)
* **[OneWeb][7]** — OneWeb broadband constellation (approximately 600 satellites)
* **[GPS][8]** — US GPS operational satellites (approximately 31 satellites)
* **[Galileo][9]** — European navigation satellites (approximately 28 satellites)
* **[GLONASS][10]** — Russian navigation satellites (approximately 24 satellites)
* **[BeiDou][11]** — Chinese navigation satellites (approximately 50 satellites)
* **[Weather][12]** — Weather observation satellites (approximately 50 satellites)
* **[NOAA][13]** — NOAA environmental satellites (approximately 20 satellites)
* **[GOES][14]** — Geostationary weather satellites (approximately 10 satellites)
* **Amateur Radio** — Ham radio satellites (approximately 100 satellites)
* **[Iridium NEXT][15]** — Iridium communications constellation (approximately 75 satellites)
* **[Geostationary][16]** — Geostationary orbit satellites (approximately 500 satellites)
* **[Science][17]** — Scientific research satellites (approximately 50 satellites)
* **All Active** — All active satellites (~9000) (approximately 9,000 satellites)

## Browse by Category
* [Space Station Tracker][18] — Track the International Space Station (ISS), China's Tiangong, and
  other crewed spacecraft in real time on a 3D globe with live orbital data.
* [Starlink Satellite Tracker][19] — Track SpaceX Starlink satellites in real time.
* [GPS Satellite Tracker][20] — Track US GPS satellites in real time on a 3D globe.
* [Weather Satellite Tracker][21] — Track NOAA, GOES, MetOp, and other weather satellites in real
  time.
* [Science Satellite Tracker][22] — Track Hubble, JWST, Terra, Aqua, and other science satellites in
  real time.
* [Military Satellite Tracker][23] — Track military and defense satellites in real time.
* [Space Debris Tracker][24] — Track orbital debris and defunct satellites in real time.
* [Communication Satellite Tracker][25] — Track Iridium, Intelsat, SES, and other communication
  satellites in real time.
* [Navigation Satellite Tracker][26] — Track GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, and BeiDou navigation satellites
  in real time.
* [Earth Observation Satellite Tracker][27] — Track Landsat, Sentinel, and other Earth observation
  satellites in real time.

## Features
* Real-time satellite propagation using SGP4/SDP4 orbital mechanics
* Interactive 3D CesiumJS globe with Natural Earth textures
* Click any satellite to see its orbit path, ground track, altitude, and velocity
* Overhead pass predictions for your location
* Conjunction (close approach) alerts between tracked satellites
* Day/night solar illumination — see which satellites are sunlit or in shadow
* Search by satellite name or NORAD catalog number
* Time controls — pause, fast-forward at 10x, 60x, or 600x speed
* Camera follow mode to track a satellite across the globe
* Cinematic mode with bloom effects for screenshots and presentations
* Satellite footprint visualization showing ground coverage area
* Sky View polar plot showing satellites overhead your location with azimuth and elevation
* [ISS][28] Live View with real-time altitude, speed, sunlit status, and crew manifest
* Observer location support with geolocation, manual coordinates, and preset cities
* Browser push notifications for satellite pass alerts with 5-minute advance warning
* [Starlink][29] train detector identifying recently launched satellites still in orbit-raising
  phase
* Historical space events timeline with 15 curated milestones from 2007 to 2024
* Orbit comparison tool to compare up to 6 satellites side by side
* Discovery panel with Famous, Records, Recent, and Decaying satellite browsing tabs
* Fuzzy search spotlight with recent searches, keyboard navigation, and random satellite picker
* Reentry tracker showing decaying satellites ranked by estimated time to atmospheric re-entry
* Shareable satellite snapshot cards with downloadable branded PNG images
* Timelapse recorder capturing the CesiumJS globe as a downloadable WebM video
* Launch calendar with upcoming rocket launches, countdowns, and mission details
* Ground station network map showing 20 major tracking facilities worldwide
* Space debris and fragmentation event tracker with known collision and ASAT test data
* Naked eye visibility mode estimating visual magnitude for satellites overhead
* Multi-language support in English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, and Chinese

status, and predicted next pass times for your location.

### What satellites can I see with the naked eye tonight?

The Naked Eye Visibility feature estimates which satellites are bright enough to see without a
telescope, based on their visual magnitude. Set your observer location and Track The Sky calculates
the best viewing times using your position and the sun angle to find sunlit satellites against a
dark sky.

Track The Sky tracks all active [Starlink][37] satellites in the public NORAD catalog, currently
numbering over 6,000 and growing with each SpaceX launch. The dedicated Starlink Train Detector

## About ViewSpace

OVERVIEW COLLECTION VENUES PARTNERS

### Overview

#### What is ViewSpace?

ViewSpace is a free, web-based collection of digital interactives and videos highlighting the latest
developments in astronomy and Earth science.

ViewSpace gives you the opportunity to explore our planet, solar system, galaxy, and universe.
Provided free with the support of NASA, ViewSpace is developed by a team of scientists, educators,
and communication specialists who collaborate to ensure that content is accurate, up-to-date,
engaging, relevant, and accessible to a wide audience.

#### Interactives

ViewSpace interactives allow you to explore objects and materials from different perspectives,
discovering how we can combine information to better understand the universe.

[Split image of a disc-shaped galaxy. The left half of the image shows visible light in shades of
brown and gray. The right side shows an infrared image in reds and blues.]

**Different forms of light:** Explore visible and invisible wavelengths of light that help us
understand features like the dusty brim of the Sombrero Galaxy roughly 30 million light-years away.

[Split image of stars and dusty clouds. The left half of the image shows visible light of the dusty
clouds in orange, brown, and blue. The right half of the image shows infrared light of the clouds in
dark smoky gray, and the stars in orange.]

**Hidden objects:** Unveil invisible light to reveal hidden objects like the stars forming inside
Mystic Mountain, a pillar of gas and dust 7,500 light-years from Earth.

[Begin Your Journey with ViewSpace Interactives][19]

#### Videos

ViewSpace videos tell the stories of the planets, stars, galaxies, and universe, giving viewers the
opportunity to experience space and Earth as seen with satellites and telescopes.

[Screenshot of a video showing the Milky Way with two features called out in detail.]

**Astronomy:** Explore the sky with stories told through spectacular imagery from space telescopes.

[Screenshot of a video titled "Where on Earth?" showing a satellite image of the Marlborough Sounds,
South Island of New Zealand]

**Earth science:** Gain new perspectives on our home planet based on data gathered by Earth-orbiting
satellites.

[Learn More about ViewSpace Videos][20]

ViewSpace is produced by the Office of Public Outreach at the [Space Telescope Science Institute
][21], in partnership with the NASA's Universe of Learning project and NASA's Earth Observing
System, Hubble Space Telescope Project, and James Webb Space Telescope Project.

ViewSpace has been exhibited in museums, planetariums, and science centers across the country since
2000.

# Where Innovation drives
# mobility — since 1901

[ Explore our solutions ][30]

## Roof, thermo and battery solutions for vehicles worldwide 

[Webasto marks its 125th anniversary with a corporate anniversary logo celebrating 125 years of
innovations as a global systems partner in mobility.]

As one of the top 100 automotive suppliers worldwide, Webasto actively supports the transformation
of the industry with decades of expertise and future‑oriented products: openable and fixed roofs,
electric high‑voltage heaters, batterie systems and thermo management solutions – our portfolio
stands for technologies that enables future mobility. Building on 125 years of continuous
innovation, we design all our solutions for series production, global scalability and long‑term
reliability. This legacy drives us today as strongly as it has throughout our history.

## Products & Solutions by Webasto

Roof

## Innovative roof systems

Webasto develops advanced roof systems: openable, fixed panoramic, convertible and sensor modules
for autonomous and marine use as system partner to OEMs
[More about][31]
[Roof systems from Webasto open up new horizons]

Battery

## Electrifying battery solutions

With OEM-specific battery solutions as well as our modular, standardized battery system, we can meet
a wide variety of customer requirements. Durability, safety and performance are a matter of course
for us and guarantee sustainable solutions for clean mobility.

[More about][32]
[#]

Heating

## Comfortable warmth

Webasto heating solutions for vehicles: high-voltage, water, air, hybrid and marine heaters
delivering efficient, OEM-grade thermal comfort and engine preheat
[More about][33]
[Heating Solutions made by Webasto]

Cooling

## Customized cooling

Upgrade your comfort and reliability on the road, sea, or RV life with cooling products from
Webasto— rooftop air conditioning, parking coolers, fridges and more!

[More about][34]
[Cooling Solutions made by Webasto]

quality control employees in the USA and Asia to inspect, demand, and ensure perfection for every
product we source.

ramp-up process is designed to empower your team and outfit them with the tools they need to
succeed. Talk to us today about how we can support your bottom line, increase your retention, and
put you on a solid track to success and profit.

Our service includes a comprehensive consult to help identify gaps and opportunities, a
comprehensive report that includes a project plan with timelines and milestones, a cost analysis,
and a schedule. We also offer a suite of quality products that will help you get there quickly and
smoothly. That’s how we ensure your success.

#### Why Us?

Business mentors are key—that’s why when it comes to client selection, we’re choosy. We want to give
each of you the time and guidance you deserve.  Whether you’re seeking a strategic alliance with the
right partner or a special skillset or tool, call us today. Together we’ll create and refine your
plan for success. We didn’t get there alone. And neither will you.

## Industry Leading Quality Control and Engineering.

#### Your Energy Storage Experts

Quality Control and performance are at the core of our sourcing accomplishments. We have a team of
quality control employees in the USA and Asia to inspect, demand, and ensure perfection for every
product we source. 





With over 200 years of combined experience, we decided to alter direction. Now, we share our passion
by helping connect our partners directly to the source and educate our customers and employees. Our
ramp-up process is designed to empower your team and outfit them with the tools they need to
succeed. Talk to us today about how we can support your bottom line, increase your retention, and
put you on a solid track to success and profit.

#### Our Approach

Our service includes a comprehensive consult to help identify gaps and opportunities, a
comprehensive report that includes a project plan with timelines and milestones, a cost analysis,
and a schedule. We also offer a suite of quality products that will help you get there quickly and
smoothly. That’s how we ensure your success.

#### Why Us?

Business mentors are key—that’s why when it comes to client selection, we’re choosy. We want to give
each of you the time and guidance you deserve.  Whether you’re seeking a strategic alliance with the
right partner or a special skillset or tool, call us today. Together we’ll create and refine your
plan for success. We didn’t get there alone. And neither will you.

What are CAFU’s operating hours?
[cafu Faq]
**Fuel Delivery
**24 hours a day, seven days a week.

**Car Wash
**From 6am to 12am, seven days a week.

Where does CAFU deliver to?
[cafu Faq]
Fuel can be delivered to vehicles parked outdoors in Dubai, Sharjah, Ajman, Umm Al Quwain and Ras Al
Khaimah. Boats and personal watercraft can be fuelled at selected Marinas in Dubai.

Car Wash services can be ordered to most locations in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and Ajman. Steam
Sanitisation is available in most of Dubai only.

Engine Oil Change services can be ordered to most locations within Dubai and Sharjah. 

Battery Service can be ordered to most locations within Dubai.

Tyre Change service can be ordered to most locations within Dubai.

Tip: A service will only show up on the app if it is available at the pinned location.
How do I manage my vehicles in the CAFU app?
[cafu Faq]
You can add or remove vehicles through the vehicle selection screen on the main page.
 
To add a vehicle:
* Go to the main menu on the application home screen.
* Select “My Vehicles”.
* Select “Add Vehicle” at the bottom of the page.
* Add your vehicle’s details and tap “Save”.

To delete a vehicle:
* Go to the main menu on the application home screen.
* Select “My Vehicles”.
* Choose the vehicle you want to delete.
* Select “Delete Vehicle” at the bottom of the page.
Which payment methods do you support?
[cafu Faq]
You can use any UAE-issued Visa, MasterCard or AMEX debit or credit cards to pay for your orders on
the app.

We do not currently accept cash or non-UAE credit/debit cards.
How can I get the most from the CAFU?
[cafu Faq]
To make the most of CAFU, keep an eye out for our latest promotions via the following channels:
* Turn on your app notifications for the latest offers and order status updates.
* Check your email for deals and promotions.
* Check your SMS messages for occasional promos from us.
* Follow us on social media for regular updates and special offers.

Khaimah. Boats and personal watercraft can be fuelled at selected Marinas in Dubai.

Car Wash services can be ordered to most locations in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and Ajman. Steam
Sanitisation is available in most of Dubai only.

Engine Oil Change services can be ordered to most locations within Dubai and Sharjah. 

Battery Service can be ordered to most locations within Dubai.

Tyre Change service can be ordered to most locations within Dubai.

Tip: A service will only show up on the app if it is available at the pinned location.
How do I manage my vehicles in the CAFU app?
[cafu Faq]
You can add or remove vehicles through the vehicle selection screen on the main page.
 
To add a vehicle:
* Go to the main menu on the application home screen.
* Select “My Vehicles”.
* Select “Add Vehicle” at the bottom of the page.
* Add your vehicle’s details and tap “Save”.

To delete a vehicle:
* Go to the main menu on the application home screen.
* Select “My Vehicles”.
* Choose the vehicle you want to delete.
* Select “Delete Vehicle” at the bottom of the page.
Which payment methods do you support?
[cafu Faq]
You can use any UAE-issued Visa, MasterCard or AMEX debit or credit cards to pay for your orders on
the app.

We do not currently accept cash or non-UAE credit/debit cards.
How can I get the most from the CAFU?

* Turn on your app notifications for the latest offers and order status updates.
* Check your email for deals and promotions.
* Check your SMS messages for occasional promos from us.
* Follow us on social media for regular updates and special offers.

transportation.

Explore our advanced battery technologies, including AGM, lithium-ion, and supercapacitors,
delivering sustainable, next-generation performance for OEMs and the aftermarket.

systems and a chemistry-agnostic approach, integrated with cutting-edge software and electronics, to
meet the needs of modern vehicles.

[marine-army]


Established in 2014, Deep Cycle Systems (DCS) is a well-known Australian technology company with the
mission to provide quality services to its clientele across global markets. With its advanced
lithium battery range, battery management systems, active cell management systems and in battery
chargers. DCS is the market pioneer in providing quality battery products that are designed using
the latest battery cell technologies, robust materials, high-end features and safety measures to
provide our clients with the best in the market.


As of 2023, Deep Cycle Systems has expanded into the European market, distributing our most popular
lithium batteries. With years of experience working with end users, government departments,
designing vehicle fleet systems and working with OEM marine and RV manufacturers, we pride ourselves
on our professionalism and dedication to our customers. Deep Cycle Systems now provides lithium
batteries to various customers across different industries throughout Europe. Our focus is currently
on the 12V Emergency Services market along with Marine & RV's.


Our batteries are similar-sized to lead-acid batteries, which makes upgrading to DCS Lithium
Batteries a simple task whilst significantly improving the battery life. DCS Lithium Batteries are
lightweight yet durable and long-lasting due to their superior construction. Our products are
designed to be used in a variety of applications, including military, emergency, marine & motorhomes
and other RV's. We manufacture our products with care and attention to detail so that they can
provide maximum service life.

#### DCS Battery Management System (BMS)

The DCS Battery Management System (BMS) project was initiated to address the shortcomings of basic
Chinese-designed BMSs, which lacked features and programmability. The goal was to create a robust,
reliable, and high-performance BMS capable of continuous high current pass through operation using
high-quality components, minimal temperature increase at peak output, and suitable for engine
cranking applications and high-temperature environments. The design also includes Bluetooth and WiFi
connectivity for app integration into cloud server, OTA updates and passes MIL vibration testing
standards.

# Batteries and Energetic Devices

[Our Products][36]

Powering Mission Success
83,828582,818482,878183
Over 3 billion hours* in space without a mission failure!
^{*}*Approximate cell hours.*
For Diverse Markets
 

EaglePicher is a leading American battery and energetic devices designer and manufacturer. We have
the capability to generate unique and technically advanced designs, then take them to production
levels that satisfy our customer’s needs. The industries we serve include:
* [Defense][37]
* [Aerospace][38]
* [Energetics][39]

## EaglePicher is Your Powerful Partner

#### Trusted Power. Innovative Power. Reliable Power.

Our niche battery technology company is the industry leader in available chemistries and
technologies, and we have the results to prove it:
* EaglePicher is the #1 U.S. battery manufacturer of thermal battery systems.
* We supply power for over 90% of the U.S. military’s munitions and mission critical systems.
* More than 600 satellites currently in orbit are operating under EaglePicher power.
* [Technology][40]
* [Products][41]

## Delivering Power

EaglePicher Technologies has been an industry leading American battery manufacturer in integrated
power solutions for nearly a century. Demands on technology call for batteries and devices that are
both smaller and lighter, yet deliver more energy and increase safety. In response to these demands,
we bring you the newest technology innovations, custom battery development, and support from concept
through production.

Our battery technology company employs over 250 astute scientists and accomplished engineers.
Working with our state-of-the-art equipment and facilities, our team creates energy storage
solutions to meet your specialized power needs. Whether it’s our cutting-edge research on
lithium-ion technology or providing power to critical defense systems, we continue to set new
standards. Our goal is to ensure that the right power is always available — not just for
convenience, but when it’s a matter of life and death.

### A Little Bit About Us

Headquartered in Joplin, Missouri, EaglePicher is an American-owned and operated battery technology
company that makes batteries by utilizing the most advanced technology and innovative processes.
Founded in 1843 as a mining and paint manufacturing business, the company entered the battery market
in 1922. In the 1940s, we were awarded our first special-purpose battery contract. After an
EaglePicher battery was launched into space aboard NASA’s Explorer 1 satellite in 1958, our
specialty battery business really took off.


### Your One-Stop Shop

Let EaglePicher provide the power and energetics solutions for your next high reliability
application. Our breadth of battery chemistries and energetic devices coupled with our ability to
design and develop system solutions makes us the most diversified American energy solution provider
in the world. When you demand the highest quality and most reliable battery performance, EaglePicher
is the only name you need to know.

[EaglePicher proudly operates as a Small Business while offering the stability and capabilities
typically associated with a Large Business. Click here to learn more.][42]

GSL ENERGY provides advanced battery energy storage systems (BESS) for residential, commercial, and
industrial applications. Our energy storage solutions support solar integration, peak shaving,
backup power, microgrids, and large-scale energy management worldwide.

### Energy Savings

When a solar system generates more energy than needed, GSL Energy's battery can store the surplus
for you instead of letting the excess energy go to waste. It can also recharge from the grid during
off-peak hours when electricity rates are lower..

### 24/7 Availability

The stored energy can be used whenever needed, whether during the day or night, or even in the event
of a power outage. GSL Energy's battery energy storage system can power your entire home, including
essential household appliances such as A/C and refrigerator.

### Cost Effectiveness

The system saves you money by analyzing your power usage patterns, weather forecasts, and utility
price predictions to ensure optimal efficiency. Excess stored energy can be sold back to the grid to
generate additional revenue.

GS Yuasa large-format LSE cells have powered flagship programs across GEO, MEO, LEO, and beyond —
including multiple Cygnus CRS missions, ISS battery replacements, Van Allen Probes, and planetary
defense programs.

Same fundamental LCO/Graphite system refined across four generations.

Proven on Long-Duration Missions

Multiple programs operating successfully beyond 15–20 years on orbit with no cell failures.

Advanced Right-Sizing Support

Proprietary life and performance modeling tools help programs accurately size batteries without
costly oversizing.

SMALLSAT POWER

## Extending Proven Performance to Smallsats

The LSE12x cell delivers GS Yuasa’s proven Gen 4 LCO chemistry in a compact 12 Ah format optimized
for high-pulse power and demanding smallsat duty cycles. The MA12x platform scales from 720 Wh to
4,320 Wh, delivering the reliability large programs have trusted for decades through rigorous
manufacturing quality and consistency.

High-Pulse Power Capability

cycles typical of LEO smallsats.

Constellation Economics

Scalable production supports rapid delivery of the quantities needed for constellation programs on
tight schedules.

Qualification Complete

Full qualification test data package available immediately. Accelerates program schedules by
leveraging existing heritage data instead of starting from scratch.

WHY LEADING PROGRAMS CHOOSE GS YUASA

## The GS Yuasa Difference

Real Flight Heritage

Not just qualified on paper. Proven across hundreds of thousands of cell-hours on actual missions,
including multiple programs exceeding 15–20 years on orbit.

Purpose-Built for Space

Unlike many competitors that adapt commercial cells, GS Yuasa’s LSE family was designed from the
ground up for the thermal, radiation, and long-life demands of space. This enables higher
performance and mass efficiency without the compromises of terrestrial designs.

Chemistry Consistency

All GS Yuasa space cells are based on the LCO/Graphite Li-ion chemistry. Only four generations have
been developed. After qualification, each generation’s chemistry is locked. GS Yuasa has held these
configurations stable for more than 15 years.

Advanced Life & Performance Modeling

Our advanced modeling tools enable EPS engineers to forecast end-of-life performance and precisely
size batteries for each mission. The result is lower mass and cost with greater confidence — the
same capability used across both large spacecraft and smallsat programs. See mission modeling
examples on the [Large Spacecraft][24] [

Company Headquarters is a comprehensive and authoritative directory hub dedicated to providing

users who are searching for reliable corporate headquarters details in one centralized location.

essential company data without subscriptions or hidden fees. Our listings include verified corporate
phone numbers, headquarters addresses, office locations, official websites, login portals, and
additional company-related information that users frequently search for online. Every detail
published on Company Headquarters is carefully reviewed to ensure clarity, accuracy, and usefulness.

headquarters data from multiple reliable sources. Each company profile goes through a detailed
process of sorting, data cleaning, and verification before it is published on our website. This

details they need, all in one convenient place.

internationally. Our structured headquarters lists are organized for easy navigation, allowing users

# Equipment Across 5 Continents][81]

[ IndianWeb2 Desk ][82]
[Friday, July 24, 2026][83] [ No comments ][84] [0][85]
L&T Heavy Engineering, the hi-tech manufacturing arm of Larsen & Toubro, has secured a series of
international orders across Asia, Africa, North America, South America and Europe, reinforcing its
position as a global leader in process plant equipment.

The business has secured orders from Africa’s largest industrial conglomerate, Dangote Group, for a
mega refinery and multi-train fertiliser expansion projects in Nigeria and Ethiopia. The scope
includes the supply of critical process equipment, comprising the world’s largest Fluid Catalytic
Cracking Reactor Regenerator Package, all critical urea and ammonia equipment.

Additionally, the business has won a repeat order from a Japanese customer for the manufacture and
supply of Heat Exchangers and Absorbers for an LNG project in Canada. The business has also secured
orders for its core equipment including Coke Drums, Fractionator Columns and Heat Exchangers from
customers in Spain, US and Brazil.

Commenting on this, **Anil Parab, Whole-time Director & Sr Executive Vice President - Manufacturing,
L&T) **said: “These orders reaffirm the trust and confidence that customers place in L&T’s
world-class manufacturing capabilities and its consistent track record of delivering high-quality
process equipment to global clients”.

Lithium batteries use advanced lithium-ion chemistry to store and deliver electrical energy more
efficiently, safely, and reliably than conventional lead-acid batteries.

1

LiFePO4 chemistry is inherently safe — no hydrogen gas, no acid spills, fully safe for apartments
and enclosed spaces.

10× longer cycle life

them far less often.
3
Zero maintenance
No water top-up, no corrosion checks, no terminal cleaning. Once installed, a lithium battery just
works.

Smart BMS technology
Built-in Battery Management System protects every cell from overcharge, over-discharge, and
overheating automatically.

Though priced higher upfront, a lithium battery costs 60–70% less over its lifetime. No replacements
every 2–3 years, zero maintenance bills, and lower electricity costs from higher efficiency.
Faster Charging
Lithium charges 3× faster than lead-acid. Your inverter is back to full charge quickly — especially
important during Pune's frequent monsoon power cuts.
Lightweight
Up to 60% lighter than equivalent lead-acid batteries. Easier to install, easier to move, and less
structural stress on your inverter cabinet.
Maintenance-Free
No water top-up. No acid checks. No terminal cleaning. Kiaan installs your GEON battery and you
never need to touch it until it needs replacing — years later.

95%+ energy efficiency vs. 75–80% for lead-acid. More of the power your inverter generates actually
reaches your appliances.
Space-Saving
Compact form factor fits in tighter spaces. One GEON lithium pack can replace two bulky lead-acid
batteries — freeing up valuable space in your home or office.

## Why Lithium is Better

Six reasons Pune homes and businesses are making the switch from lead-acid to lithium batteries.

Lower Long-Term Cost
Though priced higher upfront, a lithium battery costs 60–70% less over its lifetime. No replacements
every 2–3 years, zero maintenance bills, and lower electricity costs from higher efficiency.
Faster Charging
Lithium charges 3× faster than lead-acid. Your inverter is back to full charge quickly — especially
important during Pune's frequent monsoon power cuts.
Lightweight
Up to 60% lighter than equivalent lead-acid batteries. Easier to install, easier to move, and less
structural stress on your inverter cabinet.
Maintenance-Free
No water top-up. No acid checks. No terminal cleaning. Kiaan installs your GEON battery and you
never need to touch it until it needs replacing — years later.
Higher Efficiency
95%+ energy efficiency vs. 75–80% for lead-acid. More of the power your inverter generates actually
reaches your appliances.
Space-Saving
Compact form factor fits in tighter spaces. One GEON lithium pack can replace two bulky lead-acid
batteries — freeing up valuable space in your home or office.

# Запчасти для ноутбуков, планшетов и мобильных устройств NBDoc.ru

Наша команда вот уже более 9 лет успешно занимается оптовой продажей запчастей для ноутбуков,
планшетов и мобильных телефонов. Мы оперативно доставляем необходимое количество товара клиентам по
всей России и странам СНГ.

За время работы мы заключили долгосрочные контракты с лучшими производителями. Благодаря этому мы

# Power Solutions Private Limited.

Thank you for visiting our website. We are delighted to welcome you and invite you to discover our
journey, our values, and our commitment to powering a sustainable future. This platform offers an
insight into who we are, what we stand for, and how we continue to innovate in the evolving energy
landscape. Here, you'll also find updates on our latest products, technologies, and milestones.

Established in 2001 in Meerut, India, Radix Power Solutions Private Limited has earned a reputation
as one of India's trusted manufacturers of advanced energy storage solutions. For over two decades,
we have been dedicated to delivering products that combine superior quality, reliability,
innovation, and exceptional performance.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious—to manufacture world-class energy solutions that empower homes,
businesses, industries, and the mobility sector while contributing to a cleaner and more sustainable
future.

### Comprehensive Energy Solutions

At Radix, we believe that the future belongs to integrated energy ecosystems. Our diverse portfolio
is designed to meet the growing energy demands across multiple sectors and includes:

Lead Acid Batteries for Inverter Applications
Solar Energy Storage Batteries
Automotive Batteries
E-Rickshaw Batteries
Industrial Energy Storage Solutions
Lithium Batteries for Electric Mobility
Solar Power Generating Systems
Complete Solar Energy Solutions for Residential, Commercial & Industrial Applications

From reliable battery storage to renewable power generation, we deliver end-to-end energy solutions
that ensure uninterrupted power, maximum efficiency, and long-term value.

#### Engineering Excellence

Every Radix product is manufactured using advanced technology, modern production facilities, and
stringent quality control systems. Our focus on continuous innovation enables us to develop energy
solutions that meet international standards while exceeding customer expectations. Supported by a
passionate workforce of 350+ highly skilled professionals, we foster a culture of innovation,
precision engineering, and customer-centricity. Their expertise and dedication form the backbone of
our success and enable us to consistently deliver products our customers can trust.

#### Driving the Green Energy Revolution

As the global energy industry transitions toward cleaner technologies, Radix continues to evolve
with it.In 2025, we proudly expanded our manufacturing capabilities by launching our Lithium Battery
production facility for the E-Rickshaw segment, marking a major milestone in our journey towards
sustainable mobility. Building on this success, we are actively expanding our Lithium Battery
portfolio for Inverter and Automotive applications, reinforcing our position as a comprehensive
energy storage solutions provider. Simultaneously, we are strengthening our presence in the
renewable energy sector through our Solar Power Generating Systems, offering integrated solar
solutions that help customers reduce energy costs, improve energy independence, and contribute to a
greener planet. Our vision is to become a complete energy partner—providing advanced battery
technologies alongside intelligent renewable energy systems that power tomorrow's world.

#### Our Commitment

At Radix, quality is not merely a standard—it is our promise.

Every product we manufacture reflects our unwavering commitment to innovation, durability, safety,
and customer satisfaction. We believe that lasting relationships are built on trust, transparency,
and consistent performance. As we continue to expand our capabilities and embrace emerging
technologies, our focus remains unchanged: delivering dependable energy solutions that improve
lives, empower businesses, and support sustainable development.

#### Our Vision

To become a globally respected energy solutions company by delivering innovative battery
technologies and renewable energy systems that create a cleaner, smarter, and more sustainable
future.

#### Our Mission

To manufacture world-class batteries and energy storage solutions using advanced technology. To
provide reliable and efficient solar power generating systems for homes, businesses, and industries.

To continuously innovate and adopt emerging energy technologies.
To maintain the highest standards of quality, safety, and environmental responsibility.

Track over 9,000 satellites in real time on an interactive 3D globe. Monitor [space stations][1],

* [Earth Observation Satellite Tracker][27] — Track Landsat, Sentinel, and other Earth observation

* Real-time satellite propagation using SGP4/SDP4 orbital mechanics
* Interactive 3D CesiumJS globe with Natural Earth textures
* Click any satellite to see its orbit path, ground track, altitude, and velocity
* Overhead pass predictions for your location

* Space debris and fragmentation event tracker with known collision and ASAT test data

* Multi-language support in English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, and Chinese

## Data Source

Orbital elements (TLE/OMM data) are sourced from CelesTrak, maintained by Dr. T.S. Kelso, using
NORAD two-line element sets. Data is refreshed every two hours via a server-side proxy to provide
the most current orbital predictions.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How can I track the International Space Station (ISS) in real time?

Track The Sky displays the [ISS][36] position on an interactive 3D globe, updated every second using
orbital data from CelesTrak and NORAD. Click on the ISS to view its current altitude, speed, sunlit
status, and predicted next pass times for your location.

### What satellites can I see with the naked eye tonight?

The Naked Eye Visibility feature estimates which satellites are bright enough to see without a
telescope, based on their visual magnitude. Set your observer location and Track The Sky calculates
the best viewing times using your position and the sun angle to find sunlit satellites against a
dark sky.

### How many Starlink satellites are in orbit?

Track The Sky tracks all active [Starlink][37] satellites in the public NORAD catalog, currently
numbering over 6,000 and growing with each SpaceX launch. The dedicated Starlink Train Detector
feature identifies recently launched batches that are still visible as a bright chain of lights in
the night sky.

### How do I find out when the ISS will pass over my location?

Use the Observer Location feature to set your position via geolocation, manual coordinates, or a
preset city list. Track The Sky then calculates upcoming pass times, maximum elevation, and approach
direction for the [ISS][38] or any other satellite you select.

## About ViewSpace

OVERVIEW COLLECTION VENUES PARTNERS

### Overview

#### What is ViewSpace?

ViewSpace is a free, web-based collection of digital interactives and videos highlighting the latest
developments in astronomy and Earth science.

ViewSpace gives you the opportunity to explore our planet, solar system, galaxy, and universe.
Provided free with the support of NASA, ViewSpace is developed by a team of scientists, educators,
and communication specialists who collaborate to ensure that content is accurate, up-to-date,
engaging, relevant, and accessible to a wide audience.

#### Interactives

ViewSpace interactives allow you to explore objects and materials from different perspectives,
discovering how we can combine information to better understand the universe.

[Split image of a disc-shaped galaxy. The left half of the image shows visible light in shades of
brown and gray. The right side shows an infrared image in reds and blues.]

**Different forms of light:** Explore visible and invisible wavelengths of light that help us
understand features like the dusty brim of the Sombrero Galaxy roughly 30 million light-years away.

[Split image of stars and dusty clouds. The left half of the image shows visible light of the dusty
clouds in orange, brown, and blue. The right half of the image shows infrared light of the clouds in
dark smoky gray, and the stars in orange.]

**Hidden objects:** Unveil invisible light to reveal hidden objects like the stars forming inside
Mystic Mountain, a pillar of gas and dust 7,500 light-years from Earth.

[Begin Your Journey with ViewSpace Interactives][19]

#### Videos

ViewSpace videos tell the stories of the planets, stars, galaxies, and universe, giving viewers the
opportunity to experience space and Earth as seen with satellites and telescopes.

[Screenshot of a video showing the Milky Way with two features called out in detail.]

**Astronomy:** Explore the sky with stories told through spectacular imagery from space telescopes.

[Screenshot of a video titled "Where on Earth?" showing a satellite image of the Marlborough Sounds,
South Island of New Zealand]

**Earth science:** Gain new perspectives on our home planet based on data gathered by Earth-orbiting
satellites.

[Learn More about ViewSpace Videos][20]

ViewSpace is produced by the Office of Public Outreach at the [Space Telescope Science Institute
][21], in partnership with the NASA's Universe of Learning project and NASA's Earth Observing
System, Hubble Space Telescope Project, and James Webb Space Telescope Project.

ViewSpace has been exhibited in museums, planetariums, and science centers across the country since
2000.

## Roof, thermo and battery solutions for vehicles worldwide 

[Webasto marks its 125th anniversary with a corporate anniversary logo celebrating 125 years of
innovations as a global systems partner in mobility.]

As one of the top 100 automotive suppliers worldwide, Webasto actively supports the transformation
of the industry with decades of expertise and future‑oriented products: openable and fixed roofs,
electric high‑voltage heaters, batterie systems and thermo management solutions – our portfolio
stands for technologies that enables future mobility. Building on 125 years of continuous
innovation, we design all our solutions for series production, global scalability and long‑term
reliability. This legacy drives us today as strongly as it has throughout our history.

## Products & Solutions by Webasto

Roof

## Innovative roof systems

Webasto develops advanced roof systems: openable, fixed panoramic, convertible and sensor modules
for autonomous and marine use as system partner to OEMs
[More about][31]
[Roof systems from Webasto open up new horizons]

Battery

## Electrifying battery solutions

With OEM-specific battery solutions as well as our modular, standardized battery system, we can meet
a wide variety of customer requirements. Durability, safety and performance are a matter of course
for us and guarantee sustainable solutions for clean mobility.

[More about][32]
[#]

Heating

## Comfortable warmth

Webasto heating solutions for vehicles: high-voltage, water, air, hybrid and marine heaters
delivering efficient, OEM-grade thermal comfort and engine preheat

Upgrade your comfort and reliability on the road, sea, or RV life with cooling products from
Webasto— rooftop air conditioning, parking coolers, fridges and more!
